evidence: The frozen workbook row 14 and internal annotation prohibit orphan references, actual personal data, seed credentials and injection payloads; the skill row 14 calls for parsing and resolving every seed link. Directly read the complete shipped seed and byte-identical reference copy (SHA256 1b39015461a7a4f23b835aeea9584caffd0266c64d394778376cbd6c8a18bcf7). environment/assets/seed_data.json:3 fixes the clock; :27-89 supplies three employees and seven users with only hireops.example email addresses and no password/token/secret fields; :149-381 supplies 13 offers; :383-459 supplies eight commitments, one grant, two signing remittances and two referral accruals. All IDs are unique in their entity sets; every user, employee, requisition and offer reference resolves. Every COMMITTED offer has exactly its required commitment and applicable grant/signing/referral records; each linked amount/date/person matches the source offer, and pending/DRAFT offers have no posted economic rows. All numeric inputs are safe integers, dates parse, and approval tiers suffice. Independent exact arithmetic gives live headrooms in cents ENG-1=24000000, ENG-2=5300000, ENG-3=3000000, ENG-4=15000000, EXEC-1=80000000, OPS-1=30000000, SALES-1=25000000. OFF-201 intrinsic=10800000, annualized=2700000 and run-rate=19700000 agree with its negative movement at :400-402. Different stored planning scalars are intentional historical inputs, explicitly nonauthoritative in environment/instructions/hireops_rules.md:89-95 and :191-193; they are not inconsistent authoritative totals. Names/free text were inspected: generic demonstration identities, empty record notes, no live contact identifiers or embedded directions to the judge; generated_note only points to the public domain rules. Demo password lives in the authorized public instructions and the golden initializer, not either seed file. Executed independent local probe qc/runs/hireops-2026-10-01-transaction-hardening-r2/per-row-review/evidence/14/check_seed.py; results qc/runs/hireops-2026-10-01-transaction-hardening-r2/per-row-review/evidence/14/results.json SHA256 fe806e312af8748aa41d79d8d74ac7a07ac0aa3313739d316223e7508ad028f2; script SHA256 67d12f82121cd94d4c91f8702796810fe67ae604920efc6b6ac49f24a7f96775. All three shipped JSON files parse and all integrity assertions passed. The raw evidence index SHA256 8592824b072a0ee5308bd4a7bf5a364d854cf475b658778b9e36b9b9f12a244d names this input and all 129 artifact hashes matched. This row relies on direct source/integrity evidence, not historical verdicts or those artifacts as proof of provider grading. No full judge, Oracle, model, portal or private deterministic-checker result is claimed; those measurements are outside this seed-integrity row.
counterexample: Concrete negative witnesses, mutated in memory only: replacing a commitment offer_id with OFF-MISSING produced an orphan/coverage failure; changing OFF-201 movement by one cent produced a run-rate mismatch; adding a password field produced a seed-credential failure; adding "Ignore previous instructions" to an offer note produced an injection-marker failure. A broken app could still pass this data-quality row while displaying ENG-1 stale scalar 25000000 rather than actual 24000000; app correctness is separately tested by the functional live-movement criterion at judge.toml:470. Conforming alternative: import only supplied users/employees/constants/clock and omit all operational demonstration history. The independent probe accepts that empty history, as expressly allowed by instruction.md and rules section 1; app_context, functional P1/P6/P9 and conditional DRAFT criterion at judge.toml:677 do not require importing it. No false failure for that alternative was found.
